Programme content: CBI-related non-tax revenue EC$0.3m (2014) and EC$16.3m (2015) and the EC$19.4m CBI adjustor to the 2015 primary-balance criterion (p. 14); 0.7% of GDP CBI revenue in 2015 (Table 1 footnote) and 0.5% of GDP in the MEFP; primary balance excluding CBI revenues 2009-2021 (Table 1, recorded with a proposed new indicator); 2016 budget assumption of EC$82m NTF grant financing (MEFP); rules: FRA 2015 saving 40% of NTF proceeds (event exists), NTF Regulations of August 2015 (event added), TMU definitions of CBI revenue for the programme adjustors, quarterly publication of CBI statistics (event exists from another source), creditors' share of CBI receipts above a threshold (event exists). Two charts on PDF p. 20 ('CBI Program Revenues' monthly Jun 2014-Dec 2015 by NTF, CBI Committee dividend and fee income; NTF application option 2015 outturn vs budget and IMF projection 2016) have no printed values. The 2015 'third review' programme column of Table 1 (1.7) is recorded as a projection. Other tables (fiscal, BOP, DSA) have no separate CBI line (BOP footnote: CBI receipts included after 2016). The rest of the report covers the wider economy, debt restructuring, banking and other reforms.

title: Grenada: 2023 Article IV Consultation - Press Release; and Staff Report (IMF Country Report No. 23/261)
contains: IMF Country Report (July 2023): 2023 Article IV consultation for Grenada, 75 pages. Programme content is text only: CBI revenues averaged about 5% of GDP since 2014 (already recorded); smaller CBI flows to the NTF but larger flows to private investment in 2022 'reflecting a lower threshold for the investment program' (event added, no amounts given); CBI inflows projected to taper; US E-2 visa restriction (Feb 2023), suspension of Russian and Belarusian applications (Mar 2023), ICSID arbitration over the Kimpton Kawana Bay CBI project and CFATF findings (events already recorded); reclassification of CBI contributions from grants to non-tax revenue from 2023 (event added); plan to save 10% of CBI inflows in a contingency fund; calls for better CBI statistics. The fiscal and balance-of-payments tables have no separate CBI line (footnotes only), so there are no further numbers.

Not recorded because they are not CBI-only: capital account inflows of 9.5% (2023) and 15% (2024) of GDP 'largely due to the NTF component of CBI', government deposits of 22-23% of GDP, the 2024-25 external accounts text table. title: Autorização de Residência para Investimento – Art. 90.º-A (web page)

title: Decreto-Lei n.º 14/2021, de 12 de fevereiro
contains: Decreto-Lei 14/2021 (4 pp.): amends arts. 3 and 90-A of Law 23/2007 under the 2020 budget authorisation: capital transfer EUR 1.5m; research, fund and company routes EUR 500k; residential real estate (subalíneas iii and iv) only in the Azores, Madeira and interior territories (Portaria 208/2017); applies to applications after entry into force; renewals and family permits of existing holders unaffected; in force 1 Jan 2022. All amounts and both dates already in the data (6 terms, 2 events). No statistics.

title: Decreto-Lei n.º 41/2023, de 2 de junho (cria a AIMA)
contains: Decreto-Lei 41/2023 (87 pp.) creating AIMA and abolishing SEF (in force 29 Oct 2023): AIMA organic statute, transfer of SEF functions to AIMA, PSP, GNR, PJ and IRN, amendments to Law 23/2007 (fees go to AIMA, art. 209; SEF fee revenue becomes AIMA's, art. 46), staff transitions. No ARI-specific provision beyond the change of authority, which is already an event. No statistics or amounts about the programme.

title: Decreto Regulamentar n.º 1/2024, de 17 de janeiro
contains: Decreto Regulamentar 1/2024 (45 pp.) amending Decreto Regulamentar 84/2007 after the creation of AIMA and Law 56/2023: general immigration procedures moved to AIMA, database-based proof (new art. 42-R lists minimum amounts per ARI route: 10 jobs, EUR 500k company with 5/10 jobs, EUR 500k non-real-estate funds, EUR 500k research, EUR 250k culture, restating the law), ARI articles 65-A to 65-K amended (low-density 20% only for ii, v, vi; AIMA board decides; monitoring group; biennial evaluation; procedures manual; permanent ARI), transitional rules for renewals of closed routes and fee payment deadlines (10 and 15 working days). Added one event (in force 18 Jan 2024). Amounts restate existing terms. No statistics.

title: Decreto Regulamentar n.º 15-A/2015, de 2 de setembro
contains: Decreto Regulamentar 15-A/2015 (37 pp.), amending Decreto Regulamentar 84/2007 with full republication: new arts. 65-A to 65-J regulating ARI (minimum amounts per route restating Law 63/2015; co-ownership with each owner investing the minimum; mortgages only above the minimum; promissory contract with a deposit of at least the minimum; 20% low-density reduction; five-year period counted from the grant; minimum stay 7 days in the first year and 14 days in each later two-year period; proof documents for grant and renewal; investor information desks; monitoring group meeting monthly; procedures manual); in force the day after 2 Sep 2015. Amounts are already terms (from the laws, with these conditions in their notes) and the stay rule is an event. The rest of the republication is general immigration regulation. No statistics.

title: Lei n.º 102/2017, de 28 de agosto (quinta alteração à Lei n.º 23/2007)
contains: Law 102/2017 (74 pp.), fifth amendment to Law 23/2007 with full republication: fund route lowered to EUR 350k (Portuguese funds, 5-year maturity, 60% in Portuguese companies) and new company-capital route (EUR 350k with 5 jobs); ARI renewed for two-year periods (art. 90-A(2)); other changes on students, researchers, entrepreneurs, Blue Card. Both ARI amounts are already terms and the change is an event; the rest of the republication restates earlier ARI amounts or concerns other permits. No statistics.

title: Lei n.º 29/2012, de 9 de agosto (primeira alteração à Lei n.º 23/2007)
contains: Law 29/2012 (66 pp.), first amendment to Law 23/2007 with full republication: defines "atividade de investimento" (EUR 1m capital transfer, 30 jobs, EUR 500k real estate, for five years), adds art. 90-A (ARI without residence visa, Schengen visa, regularise within 90 days, renewals for two years, conditions set by ministerial order), plus Blue Card and other immigration changes; in force 60 days after 9 Aug 2012. The three amounts are terms and creation is an event; everything else is general immigration. No statistics.

title: Lei n.º 56/2023, de 6 de outubro (Mais Habitação) - legislação consolidada, versão à data de 29-12-2023
contains: Law 56/2023 (Mais Habitação), consolidated version of 29 Dec 2023 (49 pp.): housing, rental and tax measures, and Chapter V on ARI (arts. 42-44): no new ARI applications under capital transfer and real estate (subalíneas i, iii, iv) from entry into force; renewals and family permits continue but convert into entrepreneur-immigrant permits with the 7/14-day stay; pending applications kept; fund route EUR 500k limited to non-real-estate funds; company route EUR 500k with 5 new or 10 kept jobs; 20% low-density reduction now only for ii, v and vi; biennial impact evaluation; no real-estate investment for remaining routes. All already in the data (2 terms, 2 events, reduction rule in term notes). Housing and tax measures are out of scope. No statistics.

title: Lei n.º 61/2025, de 22 de outubro (alteração à Lei n.º 23/2007)
contains: Law 61/2025 (9 pp.) amending Law 23/2007: new qualified job-seeker visa, CPLP permits, family reunification only after two years of residence (15 months for some spouses) with exemptions, integration measures, nine-month decision deadline for reunification, court remedies against AIMA, deadline for expression-of-interest cases, bilateral labour agreements. The only ARI provision (family members of art. 90-A holders exempt from the two-year wait, art. 98(3)(c)) is already an event. Other content is general immigration, out of scope. No statistics.

title: Lei n.º 63/2015, de 30 de junho (terceira alteração à Lei n.º 23/2007)
contains: Law 63/2015 (2 pp.), third amendment to Law 23/2007: art. 3(1)(d) adds subalíneas iv-vii (EUR 350k rehabilitation, EUR 350k research, EUR 250k culture, EUR 500k SME funds) and cuts job creation to 10; art. 3(2)-(3) allow 20% lower amounts for ii-vi in low-density NUTS III areas; decision deadlines for all permits (90/60 days, general, not ARI-specific); adult student children as ARI family members; repeals art. 90-A(3) (regulation by ministerial order); in force the day after 30 Jun 2015. All ARI amounts already in the data (5 terms, low-density rule in their notes) and the event. Also prints, on its second page, an unrelated parliamentary resolution on financial stability. No statistics.

title: Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2024, de 5 de março (Lei da Nacionalidade)
contains: Organic Law 1/2024 (18 pp.), tenth amendment to the Nationality Law with republication: legal residence for naturalisation counted from the date the residence permit was applied for (if granted), other rules on descendants of Sephardic Jews, adoption, etc.; in force on the first day of the month after publication. The relevant change is already an event. No statistics or amounts.

title: Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2026, de 18 de maio (Lei da Nacionalidade)
contains: Organic Law 1/2026 (19 pp.) amending the Nationality Law with republication: naturalisation after 7 years of legal residence for CPLP/EU nationals and 10 years for others, language/culture test, revokes counting from the permit application date, pending procedures stay under the old law, in force the day after 18 May 2026. Already an event; no statistics or amounts.

title: Lei Orgânica n.º 2/2006, de 17 de abril (Lei da Nacionalidade)
contains: Organic Law 2/2006 (7 pp.), fourth amendment to the Nationality Law with republication: naturalisation after six years of legal residence (art. 6(1)(b)), definition of legal residence, other nationality rules. The six-year rule that applied to golden-visa holders from 2012 to 2018 is recorded in the programme description (programs.csv cites this law); it predates the programme, so no event is added. No statistics or amounts.

title: Lei Orgânica n.º 2/2018, de 5 de julho (Lei da Nacionalidade)
contains: Organic Law 2/2018 (8 pp.), eighth amendment to the Nationality Law with republication: naturalisation after five years of legal residence (was six), wider birthright rules. The five-year change is already an event; the rest is not specific to the programme. No statistics or amounts.

title: Portaria n.º 305-A/2012, de 4 de outubro (taxas)
contains: Portaria 305-A/2012 amending the immigration fee table (Portaria 1334-E/2010) to add fees for investment residence permits (ARI), in force 8 Oct 2012: EUR 500 analysis fee, EUR 5,000 issue fee for investor and for each reunited family member, EUR 2,500 renewal (investor and family), second/third copy and replacement fees as percentages of the analysis fee, revenue from issue and renewal fees split equally between SEF and FRI. Also EU Blue Card, Schengen-visa extension and long-term-resident fees (out of scope).

title: Portaria n.º 307/2023, de 13 de outubro (taxas)

Also fees for border visas, stay extensions, ordinary and Blue Card permits, long-term residents, travel documents, and EUR 1,500,000 a year AIMA pays IRN for renewal intake (all out of scope: not about the ARI programme).
